note: Link Purpose Icons marks links (external, new-window, download, document, app, mail, tel) with icons + screen-reader hints via a bundled JS library. All state is the config object linkpurpose.settings (route linkpurpose.settings at /admin/config/user-interface/linkpurpose, permission 'administer linkpurpose'). Seven boolean toggles purposeExternal/Download/Document/App/Mail/Tel/NewWindow (all default true), each with companion string keys (...Message screen-reader text, ...Selector, ...Class, ...Icon*). External-only booleans purposeExternalNewWindow and purposeExternalNoReferrer (both default false). Only non-empty config values are pushed into drupalSettings.linkpurpose; module skips admin routes. Medium cases set a known config value and read it back; hard cases flip a real boolean key and verify live.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module Link Purpose Icons marks several kinds of links with an icon and a screen-reader hint. Name several of the link 'purposes' it can detect (for example links that leave the site or open a new window).
evals.expected_output: It detects external links, new-window links (target=_blank), downloads, documents, app links, mailto (email) links and tel (phone) links - each a boolean toggle like purposeExternal, purposeNewWindow, purposeDownload, purposeDocument, purposeApp, purposeMail, purposeTel.

evals.prompt: Where does Link Purpose Icons store its configuration, and at what admin route/path is its settings form? Which permission is required?
evals.expected_output: All settings live in the linkpurpose.settings config object; the form is at /admin/config/user-interface/linkpurpose (route linkpurpose.settings), gated by the 'administer linkpurpose' permission.

evals.prompt: Using Link Purpose Icons on Drupal, which settings make external links open in a new window and add rel=noreferrer to them?
evals.expected_output: Set purposeExternalNewWindow (open external links in a new window) and purposeExternalNoReferrer (add rel=noreferrer) to true in linkpurpose.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Link Purpose Icons has a custom screen-reader message configured for external links. Inspect the live configuration and give the exact external-link message text.
On this Drupal site, exactly one Link Purpose link category has been turned off. Inspect the live linkpurpose configuration and state which link purpose is disabled.
evals.expected_output: purposeTel is set to false in linkpurpose.settings, so tel: (phone) links are not marked; every other purpose toggle remains true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Link Purpose Icons so that external links open in a new window. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set linkpurpose.settings:purposeExternalNewWindow to TRUE (e.g. drush cset linkpurpose.settings purposeExternalNewWindow true -y).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make Link Purpose Icons add rel="noreferrer" to all external links. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set linkpurpose.settings:purposeExternalNoReferrer to TRUE (e.g. drush cset linkpurpose.settings purposeExternalNoReferrer true -y).
